requirements:
Component: a steel part, a tube along z closed at its top by a cap, with two opposed stubs on bosses along x. It hangs from the rim of its cap while external pressure acts on its tube and on one stub.

Geometry (CAD): geometry.step, in metres, scaled so its bounding-box diagonal is 100.0 mm. Faces are named f<tag> by their face tag in this STEP file; positions below are in mm.

Material: steel, isotropic and linear elastic; E = 210 GPa, Poisson's ratio 0.3.

Service loads: a uniform pressure of 4 MPa presses on face f23, the outer cylindrical surface of the tube (centroid (0.00, 0.00, 29.58), area 4434.0 mm^2), pushing into the part. A uniform pressure of 2.1 MPa presses on face f16, the surface of the -x stub (centroid (-27.19, 0.00, 30.59), area 736.6 mm^2), also pushing into the part. No other face is loaded.

Installation and supports: face f2, the rounded rim of the cap (centroid (0.00, 0.00, 60.08), area 487.0 mm^2), is bonded over its whole area to a massive rigid mount that does not move or deform. Nothing else touches the part.

Analysis scope: static, linear elastic, small deformations, no gravity; a solid (three-dimensional) model of the whole part.

Required result: strain_energy, the total strain energy of the part, in J.

mapping.implied_by: f2 is bonded over its whole area to a rigid mount that does not move.
A uniform 4 MPa pressure pushes into f23.
A uniform 2.1 MPa pressure pushes into f16.
A solid model of the whole part.
